beats.label: S1 · The dying king names his heir
beats.text: Lucious is diagnosed with ALS and told he has three years; he pits sons Andre, Jamal and Hakeem against each other to name a successor before Empire's IPO.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's premise. Every S1 arc keys off this succession contest.

beats.label: S1 · Cookie out, Bunkie down
beats.text: Cookie returns after 17 years in prison and forces her way back into the business as Jamal's manager. Lucious silences her cousin Bunkie's blackmail with a bullet.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cookie is the show's second engine; the Bunkie murder is the crime that will bring Lucious down at season's end.

beats.label: S1 · The cover-up
beats.text: Vernon and Andre both uncover the Bunkie murder and help hide it — Vernon paying a false confessor, Andre giving Lucious an alibi that binds him to his father.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Vernon's knowledge is what makes him the FBI's eventual witness; Andre's alibi ties him permanently to Lucious's crime.

beats.label: S1 · White Party
beats.text: At the White Party, Jamal comes out by remixing Lucious's song, and Anika — betrayed after Lucious sleeps with Cookie — walks out and joins rival Billy Beretti.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Jamal's outing frees him to be heir; Anika's defection is the seed of the coalition that will try to seize Empire.

beats.label: S1 · Andre breaks
beats.text: Passed over for CEO and cut from the family album, Andre stops taking his bipolar medication and spirals into a breakdown that lands him in a psychiatric hospital.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why Andre ends the season aligned with Cookie's takeover instead of at his father's side.

beats.label: S1 · Jamal heir, Vernon dead
beats.text: Lucious names Jamal his heir. Vernon and Andre fight over the cover-up; Rhonda intervenes and accidentally kills Vernon, then tells Andre she is pregnant.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Jamal's promotion triggers the family's takeover plot; Vernon's corpse and Rhonda's pregnancy are the two secrets that will drive early S2.

beats.label: S1 · The wrong witness
beats.text: Sedated, Lucious confesses Bunkie's murder to Cookie. As the family plots a takeover, he is arrested at his legacy concert — but the FBI's witness is Vernon, not Cookie.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is exactly where S2 opens; Lucious's mistaken belief that Cookie turned him in shapes how he treats her from behind bars.

cliffhanger.text: Lucious has been arrested at his legacy concert and blames Cookie for turning him in — unaware his real accuser was Vernon, whose body Andre and Rhonda are hiding after she killed him. Cookie, Andre, Hakeem and Anika are moving to seize Empire while he sits in a cell.
questions: Can Cookie's coalition actually take Empire while Lucious is locked up?
How long can Andre and Rhonda hide Vernon's body — and her pregnancy?
What will Lucious do to Cookie when he learns she is not the one who turned him in?

characters.name: Lucious Lyon
characters.line: Empire's founder, just arrested at his own concert for Bunkie's murder; his illness turned out to be treatable and he'd already named Jamal his heir.

characters.name: Cookie Lyon
characters.line: His ex-wife, back after 17 years in prison, now leading a hostile takeover of Empire with Andre, Hakeem and Anika.

characters.name: Jamal Lyon
characters.line: Their gay middle son who came out at the White Party — Lucious's newly named successor as CEO of Empire.

characters.name: Andre Lyon
characters.line: Their bipolar eldest, briefly committed after a breakdown; now out and conspiring with Cookie against his father.

characters.name: Hakeem Lyon
characters.line: Their volatile youngest, an Empire rapper, now siding with Cookie in the takeover of the company.

characters.name: Anika Calhoun
characters.line: Lucious's spurned ex-fiancée; after catching him with Cookie she defected to rival Billy Beretti and joined the takeover coalition.

characters.name: Rhonda Lyon
characters.line: Andre's ambitious wife, now pregnant — she accidentally killed Vernon in a fight and helped hide the body.

characters.name: Vernon Turner
characters.line: Empire's fixer who covered up Bunkie's murder for Lucious — and, unknown to anyone, was the FBI's true witness before Rhonda killed him.

beats.label: S2 · Jamal was the mole
beats.text: With Lucious jailed, Cookie plots a hostile takeover of Empire with investor Mimi Whiteman. Jamal reveals he was his father's inside man all along, and the coup collapses.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The reveal reorients the whole family: it explains why Cookie fights Empire from outside all season, and why Jamal is estranged from her.

beats.label: S2 · Lyon Dynasty rises, Lucious walks
beats.text: Betrayed, Cookie starts rival label Lyon Dynasty with Andre and Hakeem, cutting out Anika. Lawyer Thirsty Rawlings gets Lucious out on bail.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Founds the rival label that structures the first half of the season and introduces Thirsty, Lucious's new fixer.

beats.label: S2 · Vernon surfaces
beats.text: Rhonda and Andre are caught moving Vernon's body; grateful, Lucious welcomes Andre back to Empire, and Vernon's discovery clears the murder charges against him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Bunkie case that put Lucious in jail collapses here — freeing him to fight for Empire and pulling Andre back to his father's side.

beats.label: S2 · Camilla topples Lucious, Anika drops Rhonda
beats.text: Mimi's wife Camilla takes control at the board and ousts Lucious as CEO. That same night, Anika pushes pregnant Rhonda down the stairs and Rhonda loses the baby.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's pivot: Lucious loses Empire and Anika commits the crime whose eventual discovery drives the finale.

beats.label: S2 · Hakeem takes the chair
beats.text: Hakeem is installed as the new CEO. Lucious confesses to Hakeem that he killed Bunkie and dares him to shoot back; Hakeem refuses.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Hakeem now knows the murder that structures the entire show, and holds a CEO chair his father wants back.

beats.label: S2 · Camilla poisoned
beats.text: Hakeem records Camilla admitting she used Mimi. Lucious catches Camilla poisoning Mimi's drink and forces her to drink it herself; he and Cookie return as co-CEOs.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Camilla and installs the co-CEO arrangement the family walks into the next season with.

beats.label: S2 · ASA bullet, altar deal, balcony
beats.text: Freda Gathers shoots Jamal at the ASAs, missing Lucious. Lucious marries pregnant Anika to block her testimony; Rhonda corners her on a balcony and one of them goes over.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The finale's three cliffhangers in a single chain — Jamal wounded, a spousal-privilege marriage, and the balcony fall the next season opens on.

cliffhanger.text: At Hakeem's wedding, Lucious has just married Anika — pregnant with Hakeem's baby — to stop her testifying against him. Rhonda, now certain Anika pushed her down the stairs, cornered her on a balcony, and one of them went over.
questions: Which of them went over the balcony — Rhonda or Anika?
Will Jamal recover from Freda's stray bullet, and can he hold the family to peace as he demanded?
Can Lucious and Cookie actually run Empire together as co-CEOs, or will the marriage to Anika detonate everything?

characters.name: Lucious Lyon
characters.line: Empire's founder, back as co-CEO with Cookie after outmaneuvering Camilla; just married Anika at Hakeem's wedding to stop her testifying against him.

characters.name: Cookie Lyon
characters.line: Folded her Lyon Dynasty label back into Empire and now sits as co-CEO alongside Lucious.

characters.name: Jamal Lyon
characters.line: In hospital after taking Freda Gathers's stray bullet at the ASAs; has demanded the family stop hurting each other.

characters.name: Hakeem Lyon
characters.line: Briefly Empire's CEO before Lucious returned; his fiancée Laura walked out of their wedding on learning Anika is expecting his baby.

characters.name: Andre Lyon
characters.line: Back at Empire on new bipolar medication; devastated by Rhonda's miscarriage and helpless as she went to confront Anika.

characters.name: Rhonda Lyon
characters.line: Lost her baby after Anika shoved her down the stairs; just cornered Anika on a balcony where one of them went over.

characters.name: Anika Calhoun
characters.line: Pregnant with Hakeem's baby and freshly married to Lucious; she is the one who pushed Rhonda down the stairs.

characters.name: Freda Gathers
characters.line: Empire rapper and daughter of Frank Gathers; shot Jamal at the ASAs while trying to kill Lucious in revenge for her father.

beats.label: S3 · Rooftop fall
beats.text: Anika and Rhonda fight on a rooftop; Rhonda goes over the edge and dies. Anika gives birth to Hakeem's daughter Bella, tying her forever to the Lyons.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Bella's existence and Rhonda's death drive Andre's grief-fuelled arc and the custody war that defines the back half.

beats.label: S3 · Feds circle
beats.text: Tariq, a federal agent and Lucious's half-brother, launches a task force against Empire and plants a hidden camera in the house. He pressures Andre to flip.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the federal threat that hangs over the whole season and ends with Tariq dead in a bathroom.

beats.label: S3 · Cookie and Angelo
beats.text: Cookie starts dating councilman Angelo Dubois and helps him win his mayoral primary. His mother Diana loathes the Lyons on sight.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Dubois family becomes the season's antagonist; without Angelo the Bella kidnapping makes no sense.

beats.label: S3 · Vegas play
beats.text: Andre partners with Giuliana, a Vegas contact, to expand Empire west. Lucious muscles in, revealing a past affair with Giuliana, and cuts Andre out of the deal.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why Andre orders the hit on Lucious that closes the season.

beats.label: S3 · Cookie chooses Lucious
beats.text: Cookie admits she still loves Lucious. Angelo flies into a rage, and Diana vows to destroy the Lyon family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The romantic pivot that turns the Duboises from rivals into enemies and triggers the war over Bella.

beats.label: S3 · Bella taken
beats.text: Child Protective Services seizes Bella; Diana Dubois has quietly adopted her as a Dubois. Leah stabs Tariq dead before he can expose them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The two shocks the finale is built on: the kidnapping the family cannot undo, and the corpse hidden in Lucious's bathroom.

beats.label: S3 · Hit at Inferno
beats.text: Lucious hands Empire to Andre and prepares to retire with Cookie. Andre tries to call off his hit on Lucious, but Shyne carries it out anyway.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The literal cliffhanger: Lucious in a coma with amnesia, Andre in charge, the hit unresolved.

cliffhanger.text: Lucious wakes from Shyne's hit with amnesia, Andre now controls Empire, and Bella is legally a Dubois while Anika sits in jail framed for Tariq's murder.
questions: How much of Lucious is left, and who gets to shape what he remembers?
Can the Lyons pry Bella back from Diana Dubois, and what will it cost them?
When Andre's role in the hit surfaces, does the family survive it?

characters.name: Lucious Lyon
characters.line: Empire's founder, shot at his own Vegas opening and left in a coma with amnesia after handing the company to Andre.

characters.name: Cookie Lyon
characters.line: Chose Lucious over Angelo Dubois and was preparing to retire alongside him when the hit went down.

characters.name: Andre Lyon
characters.line: Eldest son, newly installed as head of Empire; ordered the hit on his father over the Vegas betrayal and tried to call it off too late.

characters.name: Hakeem Lyon
characters.line: Youngest son and Bella's father, jilted at the altar in the premiere and now fighting to get his daughter back from the Duboises.

characters.name: Jamal Lyon
characters.line: Middle son, working through PTSD from being shot; reconciled with Lucious enough to record Inferno with him.

characters.name: Anika
characters.line: Bella's mother, killed Rhonda in the rooftop fall and ends the season framed by Leah for Tariq's murder.

characters.name: Diana Dubois
characters.line: Angelo's mother and the season's true enemy; has legally adopted Bella as a Dubois in revenge for Cookie humiliating her son.

characters.name: Giuliana
characters.line: Lucious's former lover and Vegas partner, now cut out of the deal and squaring off against Cookie.

characters.name: Shyne Johnson
characters.line: Street rival turned uneasy ally who pulled the trigger on Lucious at Inferno despite Andre's last-minute change of heart.

characters.name: Leah Walker
characters.line: Lucious's mother, back in the fold; stabbed Tariq to death and pinned it on Anika.

beats.label: S4 · Memory Wiped
beats.text: Five months after the Vegas explosion, Lucious wakes with no memory of himself or his family. Cookie leads him back into Empire while nurse Claudia hovers close.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's premise: amnesiac Lucious and the unexplained bomb that everyone is circling.

beats.label: S4 · Bella Taken
beats.text: Diana DuBois wages war on the Lyons, and her scheming wins Anika full custody of Bella. Hakeem loses his daughter and the family closes ranks.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the DuBois feud that drives the middle of the season and the custody stakes around Bella.

beats.label: S4 · DuBois Fall
beats.text: The Lyons expose Diana at the Captain's Ball and she is arrested, returning Bella to Hakeem. In the chaos Jamal kills Angelo, and Claudia drugs and abducts Lucious.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the DuBois arc and pivots the threat inward to Claudia and the still-unknown bomber.

beats.label: S4 · Andre Confesses
beats.text: Cookie rescues Lucious from Claudia's cabin. At a family dinner Andre admits he planted the car bomb, Lucious beats him, and the shock triggers Cookie's heart attack.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The bomb mystery finally resolves and fractures the family from the inside, resetting every relationship.

beats.label: S4 · Eddie's Play
beats.text: Family friend Eddie Barker turns out to be plotting with tech buyer Kelly Patel to seize Empire. He wins the board and pushes Lucious out of his own company.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the endgame antagonist and the corporate threat that replaces the DuBois feud.

beats.label: S4 · Shyne Killed
beats.text: Lucious discovers Shyne was also behind the Vegas bomb and has him shot dead. Eddie later surfaces evidence tying Lucious to the murder and uses it to blackmail the family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The leverage that forces Cookie's final sacrifice and hands Empire to Kelly Patel.

beats.label: S4 · Empire Sold
beats.text: To keep Lucious out of prison, Cookie trades Empire to Kelly Patel for his freedom. Anika dies in a fall engineered by Andre, and Cookie and Lucious quietly marry at City Hall.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Leaves the family married but stripped of the company, setting the terms of the next season.

cliffhanger.text: Cookie and Lucious have just married after losing Empire to Kelly Patel, when Blake's white-supremacist father opens fire at a gathering with Hakeem, Bella, and Tiana in the line of fire.
questions: Who survives the shooting, and who does not?
Can the Lyons ever claw Empire back from Kelly Patel?
How does Lucious punish Andre now that he knows Andre planted the bomb?

characters.name: Lucious Lyon
characters.line: Empire's founder, memory restored, newly married to Cookie but stripped of his company and hunted by his own guilt over Shyne.

characters.name: Cookie Lyon
characters.line: The family's strategist, recovering from a heart attack and having just traded Empire itself to save Lucious from prison.

characters.name: Andre Lyon
characters.line: The eldest son, exposed as the Vegas bomber and barely tolerated by his father after nearly being beaten to death by him.

characters.name: Jamal Lyon
characters.line: The middle son, cleared of Angelo's killing, now recording in secret with the collective Anonymous and stepping away from the spotlight.

characters.name: Hakeem Lyon
characters.line: The youngest son, engaged to Tiana, Bella back in his arms, and caught in the shootout that closes the season.

characters.name: Eddie Barker
characters.line: Longtime family friend turned traitor who seized Empire's board and is blackmailing Lucious with proof he killed Shyne.

characters.name: Kelly Patel
characters.line: The tech mogul who has just bought Empire from Cookie in exchange for Lucious's freedom.

characters.name: Anika Calhoun
characters.line: Hakeem's rival for Bella, dead after Andre drugged her and she fell from a balcony.

characters.name: Claudia
characters.line: Lucious's former nurse, arrested after kidnapping and nearly killing him in an obsessive rage.

beats.label: S5 · Starting over
beats.text: Two years after losing Empire to Eddie, Lucious and Cookie start over. Andre is jailed for Anika's murder, Jamal is in London with new boyfriend Kai, Hakeem is with Tiana.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the reset — the Lyons are outside Empire, scattered, and rebuilding.

beats.label: S5 · A new rival
beats.text: The family reunites at home to launch Lyon Family Management. At Empire, new CEO Jeff Kingsley harbours a hidden grudge against Lucious and allies with Diana DuBois.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Kingsley as the season's antagonist and the LFM/Empire split that drives the plot.

beats.label: S5 · A hidden son
beats.text: Lucious discovers Kingsley is his secret son by ex-lover Tracy. At the LFM showcase, Kingsley outs the connection to the whole family, throwing both companies into chaos.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The reveal reframes every Kingsley scene going forward and sets up the emotional stakes of his suicide.

beats.label: S5 · Damon returns
beats.text: With Kingsley exposed, the Lyons reclaim Empire and hire Cookie's old flame Damon Cross to track Eddie's stolen money. Cookie is torn between Damon and Lucious.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the Damon/Cookie affair and the federal thread that ends the season.

beats.label: S5 · Tour disaster
beats.text: Andre is diagnosed with stage-four lymphoma. On the Trust Tour, Treasure forces herself on Lucious; a furious Cookie storms to Damon's room but flees before anything happens.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Andre's cancer and the Treasure incident are the pivots that fracture the marriage and Lucious's judgement.

beats.label: S5 · A brother's heart
beats.text: Chemo destroys Andre's heart, and he plans to end his life. Kingsley, torn between his father and the FBI, shoots himself at Empire — his heart is transplanted into Andre.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why Andre is alive, why Kingsley is gone, and why Lucious enters the finale gutted.

beats.label: S5 · Marriage ends
beats.text: With the feds closing in and Lucious convinced Damon is their source, he plans to flee town with Cookie. She refuses, confesses she slept with Damon, and ends the marriage.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the state the next season opens in: Cookie out, Lucious hunted, Empire leaderless.

cliffhanger.text: Andre is alive with Kingsley's heart, but the FBI has cornered Lucious and his marriage to Cookie is over — she has left him for Damon Cross, whom Lucious believes is the informant sinking them all.
questions: Can Lucious evade Agent Conway's investigation now that Cookie has walked away?
Is Damon Cross really working with the feds, or is Lucious wrong about him?
Will Andre survive to raise the son Teri is secretly carrying?

characters.name: Lucious Lyon
characters.line: Empire's founder, on the run from the feds after his marriage collapsed and his newly-discovered son Kingsley died at his feet.

characters.name: Cookie Lyon
characters.line: Lucious's ex-wife and Empire co-founder, who has finally left him after finding comfort with Damon Cross.

characters.name: Andre Lyon
characters.line: Eldest son, alive after receiving Kingsley's heart in transplant; engaged to Teri, who is quietly carrying his baby boy.

characters.name: Jamal Lyon
characters.line: Middle son, newly married to Kai and settled back in New York after years in London.

characters.name: Hakeem Lyon
characters.line: Youngest son, separated from Tiana, rebuilding his music career and co-parenting their surviving twin Bella.

characters.name: Jeff Kingsley
characters.line: Lucious's secret son by Tracy who ran Empire and worked with the FBI to destroy him, then shot himself; his heart now beats in Andre.

characters.name: Damon Cross
characters.line: Cookie's old flame, hired to recover Eddie's stolen money; Cookie has slept with him, and Lucious is convinced he is a federal informant.

characters.name: Kai Givens
characters.line: Jamal's new husband, a reporter who is HIV-positive and publicly out about it since their wedding.

characters.name: Teri
characters.line: Andre's fiancée and hospital-wedding wife, standing by him through cancer while secretly carrying his son.
